customers_say: Customers find this smart lock to be an excellent upgrade over traditional door locks, with features including fingerprint, PIN, remote OTP, NFC card, and 5 stainless steel bolts. The installation process is straightforward, and the lock works flawlessly, with one customer noting its real-time alert functionality. Customers appreciate its security features, appearance, and value for money, with one mentioning its rose-gold/black finish.
